And yet flow and diffusion are one family: a DDIM step is the same Euler step, only on a different schedule and with a different training target. The difference comes from two things. The first is the schedule: in DDPM, by the middle of the path less than a third of the data amplitude remains, and a uniform grid spends many steps on almost pure noise. The second is what the network predicts: estimating the data from predicted noise amplifies the network's errors under heavy noise. Details are in the “Under the hood” block.

Flow matching — совсем другое семейство: Is flow matching a completely different family of models from diffusion?
Да, общего с диффузией у него нет: Yes, it has nothing in common with diffusion
Нет: при гауссовом шуме это та же модель: No: with Gaussian noise it's the same model with a different schedule and a different target, and a DDIM step is an Euler step
Да: flow matching обходится без шума: Yes: flow matching does without noise
Gao и соавторы показывают, что сэмплер D: Gao et al. show that the DDIM sampler coincides with Euler's method, and the models differ in the noise schedule, in what the network predicts and in the loss weighting. That's exactly why diffusion needed more steps in lab 3.
Обучающие пути flow matching — прямые. З: The training paths of flow matching are straight. So one Euler step is enough?
Да, прямую проходят одним шагом: Yes, a straight line is covered in one step
Нет: прямые только пути отдельных пар, п: No: only the paths of individual pairs are straight; the field is their average, and the generation paths are curved; one step leads to the mean of the data
Нет, метод Эйлера для flow matching не г: No, Euler's method doesn't work for flow matching
В лабораториях 1 и 3 один шаг собирал ве: In labs 1 and 3 one step gathered all the noise into one point. The MeanFlow authors say the same: even with straight conditional paths, the overall field usually produces curved trajectories.
Ошибка обучения flow matching должна упа: Should the flow matching training loss drop almost to zero?
Да, иначе сеть недоучена: Yes, otherwise the network is undertrained
Нет: цель x₁ − x₀ для одной точки x_t сл: No: the target x₁ − x₀ for a single point x_t is random, and even the ideal field leaves a large loss
Нет, она растёт по ходу обучения: No, it grows as training goes on
В лаборатории 2 ошибка остановилась окол: In lab 2 the loss stopped at about 1.93, and for the ideal field computed by the exact formula it is 1.87.
Чтобы обучить flow matching, на каждом ш: To train flow matching, do you solve a differential equation at every training step?
Нет: обучение — регрессия по точкам на п: No: training is regression on points along straight lines between noise and data; the equation is solved only at generation
Нет, уравнения в методе нет вовсе: No, there is no equation in the method at all
Lipman и соавторы называют свой метод si: Lipman et al. call their method simulation-free: a training step is a point on a line and one target. The equation appears at generation and when building pairs for reflow.
Да, это просто другой сэмплер: Yes, it's just a different sampler
Нет: пары нужно сгенерировать моделью за: No: the pairs have to be generated by the model over many steps and the network trained once more; at a large number of steps quality drops a little
Нет, ему нужны новые демонстрации от люд: No, it needs new demonstrations from people
У Liu и соавторов на CIFAR-10 FID на точ: For Liu et al. on CIFAR-10, FID with an exact solver rose from 2.58 to 3.36 after the first reflow. InstaFlow spent 199 A100 GPU-days to straighten Stable Diffusion and distill it into one step.

Нет: в коде t = 1 — шум, генерация идёт: No: in the code t = 1 is noise, and generation runs from 1 to 0 with step −0.1

Авторы openpi прямо пишут в комментарии,: The openpi authors say outright in a comment that the convention is the opposite of the paper. SD3 and MeanFlow also put noise at t = 1, while Lipman, Liu and this course put it at t = 0.
Пути оптимального транспорта у Lipman —: Are Lipman's optimal transport paths about pairing noise and data by optimal transport within a batch?
Нет: это условный путь — прямая от гаусс: No: it's a conditional path, a straight line from the noise Gaussian to a single data point; in-batch pairing was proposed later by Tong et al. and Pooladian et al.
Lipman и соавторы оговаривают, что услов: Lipman et al. note that the conditional flow is optimal, but that doesn't make the overall field a solution to the transport problem. Minibatch pairing (OT-CFM) straightens the paths and helps at a small number of steps.
